name: Hubert Robert

summary.text: Hubert Robert was a French painter in the school of Romanticism, noted especially for his landscape paintings and capricci, or semi-fictitious picturesque depictions of ruins in Italy and of France.
summary.title: Hubert Robert

Project for the Transformation of the Grande Galerie du Louvre
19606306: The Bastille During the First Days of its Demolition is a 1789 history painting by the French artist Hubert Robert. Following the Storming of the Bastille on 14 July 1789 at the beginning of the French Revolution, it was announced that the historic fortress and prison would be dismantled.
The Bastille During the First Days of its Demolition
19609359: A View of Ripetta is a 1766 landscape painting by the French artist Hubert Robert. A veduta, it depicts the historic Porto di Ripetta, a port that served the city of Rome.
19609404: The Ruins of Nîmes, Orange and Saint-Rémy-de-Provence is a 1789 oil-on-canvas painting by the French artist Hubert Robert, now in the Gemäldegalerie, Berlin.
The Ruins of Nîmes, Orange and Saint-Rémy-de-Provence
19609411: Girls Dancing Around an Obelisk is an oil-on-canvas painting by French painter Hubert Robert, made in 1798. The work has been held at the Montreal Museum of Fine Arts since 1964.
20167260: The Mouth of a Cave is an oil-on-canvas painting by French artist Hubert Robert, created in 1784. The painting is in the collection of the Metropolitan Museum of Art, in New York.
20167269: The Bathing Pool is an oil on canvas painting executed between 1777 and 1780 by the French painter Hubert Robert. Originally commissioned for the bathing room at the Château de Bagatelle, it is now in the collection of the Metropolitan Museum of Art, in New York.
23982009: The École de Chirurgie Under Construction is a 1773 oil painting by the French artist Hubert Robert. It depicts the École de Chirurgie, the new School of Surgery, being built in Paris.
The École de Chirurgie Under Construction
30093018: Principal Monuments of France is a series of four paintings created by the French artist Hubert Robert in 1786. They depict the ruins of several Roman structures in Provence.
